agent.defaults.conflict: The defaults changed. Refresh before resolving your draft.
agent.defaults.saved: Defaults saved. Existing cards retain their configuration.
prompts.title: Prompt management
prompts.hint: Manage Agent roles, styles and creative workflows, and feature prompts. The system maintains tool protocols, permissions and media approval.
prompts.copyHint: Changes affect new cards or tasks; existing cards and runs keep their configuration.
prompts.conflict: The prompt changed. Refresh before resolving your draft.
prompts.keyHint: For example agent.writer or feature.summary; key and purpose cannot change after creation.
prompts.name: Name
prompts.functionHint: Text generation, character/face/prop views, and scene grids use their built-in function prompts. Custom entries need an explicit consumer for their key.
prompts.builtInHint: Built-in prompts are used by existing features. They can be edited but cannot be deleted.
prompts.deleteConfirm: Delete prompt “{0}”? Existing cards and tasks keep their content.
agent.retry.exhausted: The 10-retry or 5-minute limit was reached. This run has ended; completed media is preserved.
agent.retry.stateUnavailable: Could not read run status. Try reading it again.
media.video.depthHint: Local depth inference produces a silent relative depth video at 12fps, up to 518px on its longest edge. Supports videos up to 30 seconds.
media.video.audioHint: Extract the first audio track as a stereo 48kHz WAV audio node. Videos without audio are reported explicitly. Supports videos up to 30 seconds.
media.video.resultHint: Create an independent result node linked to the source and preserve the original video.
media.video.configureFirst: No processing capability is configured. Open Function settings first.
media.functions.title: Function settings
media.functions.description: Choose processing methods and models for canvas tools independently of generation defaults.
media.functions.catalogHint: Choose published capabilities compatible with each tool in Media settings; use local processing, a model, or a third-party workflow.
media.functions.unavailable: The configured capability is unavailable or incompatible. Choose another.
media.functions.upscaleHint: Choose an AI superresolution workflow. Its parameters control scale and quality.
media.functions.compatibilityHint: Supports fixed local processing, OpenAI/Google image editing, the fixed ComfyUI image reference template, and RunningHub workflows with one image or video input. Only compatible capabilities are shown; transparency, masks, extra references and super-resolution depend on the selected capability.
media.functions.changed: Settings changed. Your draft is preserved; refresh and review before saving.
tasks.errors.videoAudioMissing: The video has no audio track to extract
tasks.errors.localVideoFailed: Local video processing failed. Check the source and media tools
tasks.errors.localVideoLimits: Local video processing exceeds the duration, pixel or file size limit
media.functions.depthHint: Extract relative scene depth into an independent depth video node.
media.functions.audioHint: Separate the soundtrack into an independent audio node.
media.functions.imageHint: Uses the method selected here, independently of the default generation model.
media.functions.configureImageFirst: Choose a processing method for this image tool in Function settings first.
resources.description: Browse saved images, videos and audio from all your projects, including historical versions. No need to save them to My Assets first.
resources.emptyHint: Completed canvas results appear here automatically.
resources.title: All resources
settings.comfy.importHint: Use Export (API) in ComfyUI, then select the JSON file or paste it here. Parsing validates configuration without running the workflow.
settings.comfy.replaceHint: Replacing the graph clears mappings and defaults. Review them again.
settings.comfy.importFailed: Unable to import the workflow. Check the file or JSON and retry.
settings.comfy.tooLarge: API JSON must be at most 256 KiB.
settings.comfy.mappingHint: Select a node and map inputs to the prompt, resource slots, or extended parameters. Unmapped inputs keep their fixed values. The canvas prompt is disabled without a prompt mapping. Links are preserved; every numbered image is required.
settings.comfy.framesHint: Frames = floor(seconds × FPS ÷ multiple) × multiple + offset. Frame count mappings also require an FPS mapping. Each task produces one result.
settings.comfy.summary: {0} nodes, {1} mappings; result node #{2}, requiring {3} reference images.
settings.comfy.promptRequired: Map at least one prompt input.
settings.comfy.durationRequired: Video requires a duration or frame count mapping; frame count also needs FPS.
settings.comfy.referencesRequired: Image numbers must be contiguous from 1, with at most 14 images.
settings.comfy.ancestryRequired: Mapped nodes must feed the selected result node.
settings.comfy.boundsRequired: Check the valid ranges for dimensions, duration and frame settings.
settings.comfy.parameterHint: These parameters appear in the canvas extended parameters table. Map a text input to the prompt and image inputs to named resource slots; unmapped inputs keep their fixed values.
settings.comfy.parameterInvalid: The parameter type, default, bounds, or options are invalid. Keep values compatible with the original node input type.
settings.comfy.duplicateMapping: A node input may only be mapped once, and parameter keys must be unique.
